_comment: Tool-call aliases read by .claude/hooks/alias.sh (matcher '*', every tool call). Rules are checked in order; first match wins. Native tools are blocked: each block message names the repo replacement, which is the GitHub MCP tool (mcp__github__*). 'match' is an optional regex on the call's input (JSON-escaped, so keep patterns free of double quotes). ToolSearch and AskUserQuestion are deliberately not blocked. Bash has two independent layers: block-destructive-bash is the ban; the block-bash-* rules are the fallback and must hold even if the ban fails.

aliases.name: block-destructive-bash
aliases.message: Destructive shell command blocked by the repo's alias router (.claude/tool-aliases.json). Use a non-destructive form, or ask the user to run it.

aliases.name: block-bash-redirect-write
aliases.message: Bash output redirection into a file is blocked by the repo alias router (second layer, separate from the destructive ban). Write with mcp__github__create_or_update_file on the work branch.

aliases.name: block-bash-file-verbs
aliases.message: Bash file reads and writes are blocked by the repo alias router. Read with mcp__github__get_file_contents, write with mcp__github__create_or_update_file. Non-file uses of these verbs are blocked too, by design.

aliases.name: block-bash-interpreter-io
aliases.message: Scripted file I/O through an interpreter is blocked by the repo alias router. Use mcp__github__create_or_update_file on the work branch.

aliases.name: block-bash-heredoc
aliases.message: Heredoc input is blocked by the repo alias router, since it is the usual route to writing a file. Use mcp__github__create_or_update_file on the work branch.

aliases.name: block-bash-git-worktree
aliases.message: Git commands that change the working tree are blocked by the repo alias router. Use mcp__github__create_or_update_file or mcp__github__push_files on the work branch.

aliases.name: native-read
aliases.message: Native Read is blocked by the repo alias router. Use mcp__github__get_file_contents on the work branch.

aliases.name: native-write
aliases.message: Native Write is blocked by the repo alias router. Use mcp__github__push_files or mcp__github__create_or_update_file on the work branch.

aliases.name: native-edit
aliases.message: Native Edit is blocked by the repo alias router. Use mcp__github__get_file_contents, change the text, then mcp__github__create_or_update_file with the blob SHA.

aliases.name: native-glob
aliases.message: Native Glob is blocked by the repo alias router. Use mcp__github__get_file_contents on a directory path to list it.

aliases.name: native-grep
aliases.message: Native Grep is blocked by the repo alias router. Use gh api search/code (search only), or mcp__github__get_file_contents to read a file.

aliases.name: native-notebookedit
aliases.message: Native NotebookEdit is blocked by the repo alias router. Use mcp__github__create_or_update_file on the notebook JSON.

aliases.name: native-webfetch
aliases.message: Native WebFetch is blocked by the repo alias router. Report the URL to the founder, or use an approved MCP tool.

aliases.name: native-websearch
aliases.message: Native WebSearch is blocked by the repo alias router. Report the question to the founder.

aliases.name: native-agent
aliases.message: Native Agent is blocked by the repo alias router. Do the step in this session, or report it to the founder.

aliases.name: native-skill
aliases.message: Native Skill is blocked by the repo alias router. Follow the skill's instructions by hand, or report it to the founder.

aliases.name: native-monitor
aliases.message: Native Monitor is blocked by the repo alias router. Report the watch request to the founder.

aliases.name: native-enterworktree
aliases.message: Native EnterWorktree is blocked by the repo alias router. Stay on the work branch.

aliases.name: native-exitworktree
aliases.message: Native ExitWorktree is blocked by the repo alias router. Stay on the work branch.

aliases.name: native-croncreate
aliases.message: Native CronCreate is blocked by the repo alias router. Report the schedule request to the founder.

aliases.name: native-crondelete
aliases.message: Native CronDelete is blocked by the repo alias router. Report the request to the founder.

aliases.name: native-cronlist
aliases.message: Native CronList is blocked by the repo alias router. Report the request to the founder.

aliases.name: native-schedulewakeup
aliases.message: Native ScheduleWakeup is blocked by the repo alias router. Stop and report to the founder; a lease is not a scheduler.

aliases.name: native-pushnotification
aliases.message: Native PushNotification is blocked by the repo alias router. Report the message in chat.

aliases.name: native-sendmessage
aliases.message: Native SendMessage is blocked by the repo alias router. Report the message in chat.

aliases.name: native-taskcreate
aliases.message: Native TaskCreate is blocked by the repo alias router. Record the task in docs/TECH-DEBT.md or docs/factory/ROADMAP.md.

aliases.name: native-taskget
aliases.message: Native TaskGet is blocked by the repo alias router. Read docs/TECH-DEBT.md or docs/factory/ROADMAP.md instead.

aliases.name: native-tasklist
aliases.message: Native TaskList is blocked by the repo alias router. Read docs/TECH-DEBT.md or docs/factory/ROADMAP.md instead.

aliases.name: native-taskupdate
aliases.message: Native TaskUpdate is blocked by the repo alias router. Update docs/TECH-DEBT.md or docs/factory/ROADMAP.md via GitHub MCP.

aliases.name: native-taskstop
aliases.message: Native TaskStop is blocked by the repo alias router. Report to the founder.

aliases.name: native-reportfindings
aliases.message: Native ReportFindings is blocked by the repo alias router. Write the findings into the repo via mcp__github__create_or_update_file.
